title: filix-mas goldieana
intro: Filix-mas goldieana, commonly known as Goldie's Fern or possibly the Maidenhair Fern, is a species of fern. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Adiantaceae. The health benefits of Goldie's Fern include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
